_readme: Per-endpoint and per-transaction policies. First matching pattern wins. allowedPurposes: purposes permitted here (null = any purpose). maxRisk: risk ceiling for this endpoint. requireVerified: a Web Bot Auth verified identity is required. requireMandate: a delegated-authority mandate (AP2) is required — transactions. transactions: this endpoint performs a transaction on someone's behalf.

endpoints.description: Order lookup and placement act on a customer's behalf — a delegated mandate is required.
Account-shaped data: only order-status agents may touch it, and only at low risk.
Sensitive paths are never allowed for agents — the guard refuses these outright.
Undocumented API surface: permitted purposes only, risk ceiling 75.
The sanctioned MCP door: tool calls go through the guard like any other request.
